body_markdown:
Western Products, a Douglas Dynamics brand, recently celebrated a major milestone—its 75th anniversary! Local Milwaukee news station TMJ4 highlighted Western’s legacy in a special segment, featuring familiar faces from our team and showcasing the company’s ongoing commitment to innovation, quality, and service.


The segment captures Western’s journey over the past 75 years, from its beginnings in 1950 as a small machine shop in Milwaukee to becoming a leader in snow and ice control equipment. It also highlights the recent anniversary celebrations at the Milwaukee facility, where employees, retirees, families, dealers, and suppliers enjoyed plant tours, interactive displays, and entertaining activities.


We’re proud to share this story. Watch the segment below and join us in celebrating 75 remarkable years of Western Products—honoring the past, celebrating the present, and looking ahead to the next 75!
